behavior: The agent gateway builds a trusted Arc Mainnet USDC quote before payment.
The payer is bound to payload.authorization.from and an optional expectedPayer.
The quote is checked for the exact scheme, Arc network, Arc USDC asset, server recipient, amount, and EIP-3009 transfer method.
inspectAuthorization verifies the EIP-3009 authorization and the gateway accepts it only when verdict.decision is allow.
Request IDs and authorization nonces are tracked to reject replay or request reuse with different payment data.
Only after verification does api/agent-actions.js settle the authorization and execute launch, buy, sell, or collect-fees.
integration.claimBoundary: This proof documents the wormhole-x402 integration used by Arcane. It does not claim that Arcane is registered in the AgentWormhole registry; no registry registration API or listing was verified.
